summary: NOAA Spitsbergen Atlantic Current describes northwestward flow off southwest Spitsbergen. The modern West Spitsbergen Current is a northward Atlantic-water continuation toward Fram Strait. Regional overlap does not establish identical names, branches or endpoints; no existing West Spitsbergen route length is transferred.
